title: AAA-RNS: AI Agent-driven Autonomous Research Notebook System
description: An offline, server-free research notebook that builds a project-specific documentation system from a laboratory's own planning documents, drafts research notes from uploaded experiment logs and measurement data, links every generated sentence to an entry in an evidence ledger, and refuses to seal a note containing a claim the ledger does not support. Sealed notes are chained with a SHA-256 hash covering both content and signatures. Runs entirely in the browser with no external dependencies, in Korean, English and Japanese.
